title: One working day at Ada's Kitchen
headline: One working day at *Ada's Kitchen*
sub: Orders, riders, stock, money and deals, all run alongside her chats.

bridge.en: It starts with opening her shop.
bridge.pcm: Everything start with how she go open her shop.

flow.purpose: cold open: a busy kitchen at 7am
flow.action: Stirs a large pot of jollof with one hand while her phone buzzes again on the counter; she glances at it, laughs softly and shakes her head
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window onto a yellow-painted wall, a counter with a receipt printer
flow.camera: slow push-in, medium shot, warm morning light

flow.goes: closing, after the footage, before the call to action
flow.action: Wipes down the steel counter at the end of the day, checks her phone, smiles with quiet pride and turns off a light
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window onto a yellow-painted wall, a counter with a receipt printer, evening lamp light
